images.caption: Randolph Air Force Base Girl Scouts present the U.S. flag to Air Force Col. Soledad Lindo-Moon, the 359th Medical Group commander, during the annual Girl Scout Flag Retreat Ceremony at Randolph Air Force Base, TX, March 8, 2011. The ceremony was attended by representatives of the Girl Scouts of Southwest Texas, area mayors, school officials and Air Force leadership. (DoD photo by David Terry, U.S. Air Force/Released)

images.caption: From left, U.S. Air Force Airman 1st Class Oscar Bodden, roleplaying an aircraft hijacker, surrenders to Staff Sgts. Edmund Grant and Thomas Valenzuela and Airmen 1st Class Jessee Angulo and Adam Dunnam during a training exercise at Randolph Air Force Base, Texas, Dec. 6, 2010. The security forces Airmen are assigned to the 902nd Security Forces Squadron. (DoD photo by Dave Terry, U.S. Air Force/Released)

images.caption: Chief Master Sgt. of the Air Force James A. Roy speaks to students of the Gaylor Airman Leadership School at Randolph Air Force Base, Texas, June 3, 2010. Roy spoke to the students about expanding leadership training to include sister service and international students and about the role family support plays in enhancing the Air Force's mission. (DoD photo by Steve Thurow, U.S. Air Force/Released)
